item.title: 2 Bucks County teens arrested after IED tossed at New York City protest
item.description: Two Bucks County teens were arrested in connection with an IED thrown at an anti-Muslim protest outside Gracie Mansion in New York City on Saturday.

item.title: Pa. state police trooper shot and killed in Chester County [Updated]
item.description: A Pennsylvania state police trooper was shot and killed during a traffic stop in West Caln Township on Sunday night, Gov. Josh Shapiro said.

item.title: Romance books convention will have a second chapter

item.title: Local restaurants: Health inspectors report on area eateries
item.description: The state Department of Agriculture released reports of inspections of restaurants and school cafeterias in Lackawanna County conducted between Feb. 15 and Feb. 28.

item.title: POINT: Time changes have advantages year-round
item.description: America’s current daylight saving time system — spring-to-fall DST followed by winter standard time — is an excellent compromise, providing all of DST’s many benefits for the majority of the year and yet avoiding winter DST’s difficulties during the dark, cold months. item.title: 60th class reunion
item.description: Northeast High School class of 1965 recently celebrated its 60th class reunion at the VFW in Dupont, dining and renewing friendships.

item.title: UNICO Foundation donates to St. Francis of Assisi Kitchen
item.description: The UNICO Foundation recently presented a check in support of St. Francis of Assisi Kitchen in Scranton. The funds were granted from the Torraco Food Bank/Shelter Fund set up by member Ralph Torraco in an effort to assist those in need of food and shelter. With the motto of “Service Above Self,” the endowment was established so families and children will be given a safe haven and never go hungry.
